messages:
erin: ap-north-1 GPU nodes failing to complete bootstrap since 14:02 UTC, warm pools not filling.
harrison: logs: `certificate fetch failed` and `KMS access denied` from init container.
mei: I merged fw delta to block outbound telemetry to internet collectors. Did we overlook VPC endpoints and KMS policies?
policy-bot: policy apply detected: egress-lockdown-apn1 by mei at 2026-08-09T14:00:12Z.
erin: tcpdump shows RSTs to the KMS public IP ranges and 403s from the KMS VPC endpoint due to restrictive endpoint policy.
harrison: So two issues: firewall denied public KMS egress and the VPC endpoint policy is too strict for the bootstrap role. Nodes can't get certs or decrypt bootstrap tokens.
mei: Rolling back the fw change now. Also patching the endpoint policy to include the bootstrap role temporarily.
infra-bot: rollback initiated for egress-lockdown-apn1.
erin: After the patches I see successful STS and KMS calls in init logs:
```
2026-08-09T14:05:21Z init: sts:AssumeRole -> 200 OK
2026-08-09T14:05:22Z init: KMS Decrypt -> 200 OK
2026-08-09T14:05:47Z join: node registered to pool-gpu-apn1a
```
finance: fallback warm pools in us-west-2 added ~1.8k USD/hr during the incident window. tagging finance for reconciliation.
policy-bot: security finding logged SEC-2026-501. Recommend VPC endpoint policy template and Privatelink request.
mei: Follow-ups: 1) standard VPC endpoint policy template that whitelists bootstrap roles 2) add egress smoke test (STS + KMS decrypt) to the fw canary pipeline 3) update fw PR checklist to validate endpoints and IAM impacts 4) require auto-expiring ephemeral allowlist if used.
harrison: I'll open INC-2026-512 and attach CloudTrail, init logs, and the endpoint policy diff.
erin: Playbook snippet for oncall in the incident page:
```
- check nodes: `kubectl get nodes | grep NotReady`
- fetch init logs: `kubectl -n infra logs <init-pod>`
- grep for STS/KMS/certificate errors: `grep -E "AssumeRole|KMS|certificate|decrypt" init.log`
- tcpdump to verify RSTs to public kms IPs
- if endpoint policy blocks: patch to allow bootstrap role or revert policy
- if fw blocks: revert or add ephemeral allowlist with TTL <= 30m
- monitor: `prometheus:autoscaler.node_join_rate` and `grafana:gpu-warmup`
```
policy-bot: scheduling design review next week for VPC endpoint standards and least-privilege egress.
mei: thanks team. Closing thread once INC-2026-512 has the postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
